description: Small controlled regression set with expected outcomes asserted by the repository's tests. These are not independent Linux-kernel ground truth labels.

cases.expected: candidate_lock_order_cycle for the normal_a/normal_b lock sequence
cases.basis: tests/test_phase4.py asserts a normal candidate with source locations and a closed lock sequence

cases.expected: interrupt_aware_candidate for the cross_a/cross_b process-to-hardirq cycle
cases.basis: tests/test_phase4.py and tests/test_interrupts.py assert handler, context transition, provenance and locations

cases.expected: blocked_a/blocked_b must not be an interrupt_aware_candidate; its hypothetical cycle is rejected as infeasible under the same-CPU hardirq model
cases.basis: tests/test_phase4.py checks rejected_candidate and the explicit interrupt_preemption_rejected edge

cases.expected: release_before_next_acquire must not produce a state_a-to-state_b lock dependency
cases.basis: tests/test_phase4.py checks that the lock release ends the dependency

cases.expected: ambiguous_a/ambiguous_b remains inconclusive when CFG join merges enabled and disabled IRQ states
cases.basis: tests/test_phase4.py asserts an inconclusive finding rather than candidate or rejected
